description: Composite bright-field TEM figure of as-cast Fe-30Mn–10Al–1.5C–0.5Be low-density steel, mixing micrographs with selected-area electron diffraction patterns. (a) is a low-magnification BF-TEM micrograph with a 5 μm scale bar, showing large bright, angular-to-needle-shaped precipitates against a darker, dislocation/vein-contrast matrix; a green box labelled "B" and a red box labelled "A" mark the regions enlarged in (c) and (b). (b) is the enlargement of area A (1 μm scale bar) with a "SADP" aperture circle placed on the precipitate; (c) is the enlargement of area B (1 μm scale bar), also with a "SADP" circle on the precipitate. (d) and (e) are SAED patterns, both labelled "Be12Fe": (d) is taken along the [1̄13] zone axis with red index labels (including 301) beside selected reflections, and (e) along [001] with the 101, 202 and 101 reflections circled in red. The figure argues that the coarse precipitates imaged in (a–c) are the Be12Fe compound, identified crystallographically by the two zone-axis patterns. No composition spectrum or numeric property is plotted; the citing text states the precipitates measure 5–10 μm. Camera length/accelerating voltage are not printed.
measured_quantities: scale bar length (μm): 5 μm in (a), 1 μm in (b) and (c)
precipitate size (μm) as stated in the citing text (5–10 μm)

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a bright-field TEM micrograph of the as-cast 0.5Be steel with a 5 μm scale bar, showing large bright precipitates with angular to needle-like outlines in a darker matrix with vein-like dislocation contrast.
Panel (a) carries two coloured rectangles: a green box labelled "B" at lower left and a red box labelled "A" at lower right, indicating the areas enlarged in panels (c) and (b) respectively.

Panels (b) and (c) are enlarged bright-field images of areas A and B with 1 μm scale bars, each carrying a blue "SADP" label with a circle marking the selected-area diffraction aperture position on the precipitate.
Panel (d) is an SAED pattern labelled "Be12Fe" with the zone axis printed as [1̄13] and red index labels beside reflections, one clearly reading 301.
Panel (e) is an SAED pattern labelled "Be12Fe" with the zone axis printed as [001]; red labels 101, 202 and 101 appear on the reflection array, with red circles drawn around selected spots.
The figure comprises five panels: three bright-field TEM micrographs (a–c) and two selected-area diffraction patterns (d, e); no spectrum, composition map or property plot is present.

The caption states the figure is bright-field TEM morphology of as-cast Fe-30Mn–10Al–1.5C–0.5Be low-density steel, with (a–c) morphology, (b) the enlarged view of area A, (c) the enlarged view of area B, and (d, e) selected area diffraction patterns of Be12Fe.
The citing text states that Fig. 3(a) shows the morphology of Be–Fe precipitates whose size is 5–10 μm in the as-cast 0.5Be steel.
The citing text states the diffraction pattern of Be–Fe was taken from the precipitate along the [−113] and [001] zone axes, matching the zone-axis labels printed in panels (d) and (e).

The citing text refers to the phase identified in the diffraction patterns as the Be12Fe compound, and notes that in the 1.5Be steel large Be–Fe precipitates intersect horizontally and vertically (shown in Fig. 4, not this figure).
No numeric scale, camera constant, accelerating voltage or d-spacing values are printed in the diffraction patterns (d) and (e); only Miller indices and zone axes are given.

The caption lists panel designations in the order "(a–c) morphology", but panels (b) and (c) are explicitly the enlarged views of areas A and B marked in (a), so the magnification sequence is (a) low → (b), (c) high.

subfigures.description: Low-magnification bright-field TEM micrograph of as-cast 0.5Be steel, 5 μm scale bar. Large bright, blocky-to-needle-shaped precipitates (lighter contrast) are embedded in a darker matrix showing vein/banded dislocation contrast. A green rectangle labelled "B" (lower left) and a red rectangle labelled "A" (lower right) indicate the areas enlarged in (c) and (b).

Enlarged bright-field view of area A (red box) with a 1 μm scale bar, showing the elongated/needle-like bright precipitate against darker matrix; a blue "SADP" label with a circle marks where the selected-area diffraction pattern was taken.
Enlarged bright-field view of area B (green box) with a 1 μm scale bar, showing a bright precipitate/matrix interface; blue "SADP" label with a circle marks the selected-area aperture position.

Selected-area diffraction pattern labelled "Be12Fe" in red, taken along the [1̄13] zone axis (printed bottom-left in red). Red index labels are placed near bright reflections, including "301"; other index labels are only partially legible. Diffuse/streaked intensity between spots is visible.

Selected-area diffraction pattern labelled "Be12Fe" in red, taken along the [001] zone axis (printed bottom-left in red). A square array of reflections is visible with red index labels 101, 202 and 101, and red circles drawn around selected spots.
